title: Corpsegrinder

sources.title: Grand Slam
markers: | description = Slam your weapon into the ground, dealing additional {{DamageType|Thunder}} damage equal to your [[proficiency bonus]], thunderously impacting nearby foes and possibly pushing them away.

summary: This +2 maul can slam creatures in a 10 ft area and push them away.

fields.Grand Slam: Action once per Short Rest. In a 10 ft circle, deal normal weapon damage plus extra Thunder damage equal to your proficiency bonus. A Dexterity save against weapon-action DC +2 halves the damage. Failed saves can cause a push. This uses the full Action and does not count toward Extra Attack.
fields.Reported behavior: The pinned source reports Large and larger targets can be pushed despite the tooltip. The slam makes no attack roll, so riders requiring a roll can be absent.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details and pinned item and rules evidence. Expanded the card from the pinned item and linked gameplay evidence.
